text:
maria: Heads up — webinar next Wed. We need final competitive messaging + a one-page battlecard for SDRs. Can we sync on positioning vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors? Draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/comp-messaging-draft :eyes:

alex: On it. I'll refresh the one-pager. High-level framing suggestion: vs clouds = predictable cost & routing, vs LLM APIs = serving control & SLAs, vs infra vendors = integrated developer UX. Short and punchy.

tj: Agree with the framing. Also propose a quick demo narrative showing automatic quantized fallback to reduce cost during bursts — good for infra-y buyers.

olivia: SDRs need 3 bullet scripts + one objection handler for "we have cloud endpoints". I'll prepare distilled copies they can copy/paste into HubSpot sequences.

sam: I'll own the webinar slides and benchmark slide. Quick Q: which cloud baselines do we call out? AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex, Azure OpenAI ok?

maria: Yes include those three. Benchmarks should focus on 99th pct latency, per-token cost, and failure/retry behavior (how each handles capacity pressure). Avoid raw FLOPS or model internals.

alex: Drafted two lead-routing rules: "high-cost, low-latency" -> AE handoff; "high-volume batching" -> PLG self-serve/Dedicated presales. Add "regulated" -> Private sales. Thoughts?

olivia: :thumbsup: Add a 10-word pitch for each routing bucket so SDRs can triage quickly.

sam: Are we publishing benchmark notebooks? Legal ok with model names? Need clarification before we link notebooks.

maria: Legal cleared methodology + anonymized baselines. We can't publish raw model weights or internal license artifacts. Publish notebooks that reproduce methodology with placeholders.

alex: Battlecard plan: single-sided PDF with signals (cost, lat, retries), elevator hooks, 3 objection scripts, and routing tags. Make it a HubSpot attachment + Airtable row.

tj: I'll add a tiny SRE script snippet showing graceful fallback + circuit-breaker messaging for sales to cite during technical calls. Helps with SLA conversations.

olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/137 — contains SDR scripts and an initial battlecard template. Please review and comment.

maria: Nice. Deadline: EOD Monday to consolidate all assets. Owners: Alex (battlecard + routing), Sam (bench slides + notebook), Olivia (SDR scripts + PR), TJ (demo narrative + SRE snippet). Ping me if blocked.

deploy-bot: Calendar updated: Webinar "Serving Smarter: Inference that Scales" — 2026-03-28 10:00 PDT.

maria: Thanks team — small sprint but high impact. We'll do a dry run Tues morning.
